name: Triple confluence, slow swing: fear + VIX + funding flush with a long 25-day patience hold
rationale: Thesis: the cross-market stress triple (fear_greed extreme-low + vix_level elevated + funding_rate flushed) marks a regime bottom whose RECOVERY plays out over weeks, not days. A patient long hold (up to 25d) should harvest the full mean-reversion-to-trend leg, not just the dead-cat bounce, while the rare entry keeps turnover — and thus fees — negligible. All three axes bounded levels. Long-only spot. Disconfirmer: run the SAME triple with a SHORT max-hold (≤8 days); the slow version must beat the fast one on deflated Sharpe net of fees. If the short hold matches, the edge is the immediate bounce and the long hold only adds decay and whipsaw — there is no slow-reversion premium. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: cross-market stress triple opening a multi-week recovery window
